titleEn: Linking words: although, however, because of
titleAr: أدوات الربط: although و however و because of
explanationAr: أدوات الربط تجعل الكتابة واضحة. although تربط جملتين في جملة واحدة: Although it rained, we finished the work. أما however فتأتي غالبًا في أول جملة جديدة وبعدها فاصلة: It rained. However, we finished the work. ولا نجمع although و but في جملة واحدة، كما قد نفعل في العربية («مع أنه... لكن...»). وللسبب نستخدم because مع جملة، و because of مع اسم: because the road was closed، و because of the rain.
explanationEn: Linking words make writing clear. Although joins two ideas in one sentence: Although it rained, we finished the work. However usually starts a new sentence and has a comma after it: It rained. However, we finished the work. Do not use although and but together. Use because with a clause and because of with a noun: because the road was closed, because of the rain.

comparison.ar: مع أن المضخة جديدة، إلا أنها مزعجة.
comparison.en: Although the pump is new, it is noisy.
We stopped because of the rain.

examples.en: Although the test was long, it was useful.
examples.ar: مع أن الاختبار كان طويلًا، فقد كان مفيدًا.

examples.en: The design is good. However, it is expensive.
We stopped because of the strong wind.
The team worked late, so the report was ready on time.
examples.ar: عمل الفريق حتى وقت متأخر، فكان التقرير جاهزًا في موعده.

exercises.sentence: Although the pump is new, but it is noisy.
accepted: Although the pump is new, it is noisy.
The pump is new, but it is noisy.
exercises.explanationAr: لا نجمع Although و but في جملة واحدة.

exercises.prompt: We stopped the work ___ the rain.
exercises.explanationAr: the rain اسم، فنستخدم because of.

exercises.prompt: The plan is good. ___, it needs more time.
exercises.explanationAr: However في أول جملة جديدة وبعدها فاصلة.

exercises.prompt: ___ it was late, the team continued working.
exercises.explanationAr: Although تربط فكرتين متعارضتين في جملة واحدة.

exercises.sentence: Because of the road was closed, we were late.
accepted: Because the road was closed, we were late.
exercises.explanationAr: بعد because of يأتي اسم، أما الجملة فتأتي بعد because.

exercises.prompt: I called him ___ I needed the file.
exercises.explanationAr: I needed the file جملة، فنستخدم because.
